# Test inventory

<!-- GENERATED by tools/generate_test_inventory.py -- do not edit by hand. -->

What lsdtt3 is tested with, by **evidence** (how a test knows its answer) and **level** (unit or system). The categories are defined in [`lsdtt3_architecture.md`](lsdtt3_architecture.md#testing-categories) and [`testing_and_benchmarking.md`](testing_and_benchmarking.md). A test with several evidence labels is counted under each, so rows sum to more than the number of tests. `.` means none.

CTest counts are for the configuration `LSDTT_ENABLE_PYTHON_TESTS=ON`, `LSDTT_ENABLE_PYTHON_GEO_TESTS=ON`, `LSDTT_ENABLE_NETWORK_TESTS=ON`, `LSDTT_ENABLE_BENCHMARKS=OFF`, `LSDTT_ENABLE_PERF_TESTS=OFF`; the benchmark and performance tiers are not included. Python counts are test functions and methods (a parametrised function counts once).

Regenerate with `python3 tools/generate_test_inventory.py --build-dir build --update` after adding or relabelling tests; the CTest test `unit_test_inventory_is_current` fails while this file is stale.
